"""
Project Title: Graph Neural Network for Node Classification on Cora (ai-ml-ds-GNNNodeClass2025)
File Name: advanced_graph_node_classification_with_spektral.py

Short Description:
This project builds an end-to-end GNN model using Keras and Spektral to perform node classification on the Cora citation network.
It uses message-passing GCN layers, train/validation/test splits, early stopping, learning rate scheduling, and evaluation metrics.
Includes multiple example inferences for testing and edge-case handling.
"""

import os  # type: ignore
import datetime  # type: ignore
import numpy as np  # type: ignore
import tensorflow as tf  # type: ignore
from tensorflow.keras import layers, Model, Input  # type: ignore
from tensorflow.keras.callbacks import EarlyStopping, ReduceLROnPlateau  # type: ignore
from spektral.datasets import citation  # type: ignore
from spektral.layers import GCNConv  # type: ignore
from spektral.transforms import LayerPreprocess  # type: ignore

# ------------------------------
# 1. Load and preprocess Cora dataset
# ------------------------------
dataset = citation.Cora()  # type: ignore
graph = dataset[0]
A: tf.Tensor = graph.a.tocoo().astype("float32")  # adjacency
X: np.ndarray = graph.x.astype("float32")  # node features
y: np.ndarray = tf.keras.utils.to_categorical(graph.y, dataset.n_labels)  # one-hot labels

idx_train = graph.mask_tr
idx_val = graph.mask_va
idx_test = graph.mask_te

A_norm: tf.Tensor = LayerPreprocess(GCNConv)(A)  # GCN normalization

# ------------------------------
# 2. Define GCN model architecture
# ------------------------------
N: int = X.shape[0]
F: int = X.shape[1]
n_labels: int = dataset.n_labels

X_in = Input(shape=(F,), name="X_in")
A_in = Input(shape=(N,), sparse=True, name="A_in")

gc1 = GCNConv(16, activation="relu")([X_in, A_in])
gc2 = GCNConv(n_labels, activation="softmax")([gc1, A_in])

model = Model(inputs=[X_in, A_in], outputs=gc2)
model.compile(optimizer="adam", loss="categorical_crossentropy", weighted_metrics=["acc"])
print(model.summary())

# ------------------------------
# 3. Train model with callbacks
# ------------------------------
es = EarlyStopping(patience=50, restore_best_weights=True)
rlr = ReduceLROnPlateau(patience=10, factor=0.5, verbose=1)

history = model.fit(
    x=[X, A_norm],
    y=y,
    sample_weight=idx_train,
    validation_data=([X, A_norm], y, idx_val),
    epochs=300,
    batch_size=N,
    callbacks=[es, rlr],
    shuffle=False,
    verbose=2,
)

# ------------------------------
# 4. Evaluate on test set
# ------------------------------
eval_results = model.evaluate([X, A_norm], y, sample_weight=idx_test, batch_size=N, verbose=0)
print(f"Test Loss: {eval_results[0]:.4f}, Test Accuracy: {eval_results[1]:.4f}")

# ------------------------------
# 5. Example Inference
# ------------------------------
def inference_example(node_idx: int):
    """
    Predict class label for a specific node.
    Input: node index (int)
    Output: predicted label and probabilities
    """
    logits = model.predict([X, A_norm], batch_size=N)  # shape: (N, n_labels)
    probs = logits[node_idx]
    pred_label = np.argmax(probs)
    print(f"Node {node_idx} predicted: {pred_label}, prob={probs[pred_label]:.4f}, all={probs}")

# Example inputs and expected outputs
print("=== Example Inference ===")
inference_example(10)
inference_example(100)

Key Learnings & Research Areas

  • GCN layers & message passing in Spektral using sparse adjacency (keras.io, link.springer.com, en.wikipedia.org, en.wikipedia.org)
  • Graph node classification with train/val/test masking
  • Callbacks: EarlyStopping and ReduceLROnPlateau for robust training
  • Dense inputs for full-graph learning

Problem Domain

  • Graph representation learning, node classification on citation networks

Use Cases

  • Academic paper classification via citation networks
  • Social network user-type identification
  • Fraud detection in transaction or communication graphs

Frameworks Used

  • TensorFlow/Keras, Spektral
